right.raw_text: This criterion is intended to exclude patients who have been prescribed CPAP but are unwilling or unable to use it.

Pregnant or breastfeeding women should be excluded from the study due to the unknown effects of the study drug on the fetus or infant.
Women of child-bearing age (WOCBA) not willing or unable to use an accepted method to avoid pregnancy for the entire duration of the study should be excluded from the study.
Prisoners or subjects who are involuntarily incarcerated should be excluded from the study.

left.raw_text: Subjects who are compulsorily detained or treatment of either a psychiatric or physical (i.e. infectious disease) illness should be excluded from the study.
